purpose: The executive cockpit renders canonical truth; it never owns a competing management state, KPI truth, roadmap truth, action truth, timeline truth or knowledge truth.
knowledgeProjectionRule: Universal Knowledge is projected through the canonical Memory truth class; BG167 verification is projected through Evidence; replay obligations are projected through Execution plus Evidence. VERIFIED still requires BG167 readback and BLOCKED obligations remain visible until replay closure.
writeRule: All mutations must target the owning canonical service through its governed command/action interface; cockpit-local writes may contain only ephemeral UI state.
proofRule: A rendered value is production-trustworthy only when its canonical source identity and freshness/evidence can be traced from the projection.
